name: First light
description: A luminous orbital emblem suspended above a pixel wordmark.

name: Type in space
description: Oversized cropped lettering becomes the landscape; a tiny orbit gives it scale.

name: Lunar rise
description: A low lunar horizon and a small rising star create a cinematic opening.

name: Acquisition
description: A precise circular radar fills the right side while launch information stays on the left.

name: The field guide
description: A cream book-jacket layout pairs elegant type with a tall astronomical plate.

name: Night garden
description: A quiet pixel landscape, a distant moon, and a small illuminated workstation.

name: Boot poetry
description: An amber monochrome terminal treats startup as a short, carefully typeset poem.

name: Observatory
description: A vaulted window frames a dense star field in a quiet plum interior.

name: Orbital mechanics
description: An engineering drawing with offset ellipses, measured axes, and restrained labels.

name: Totality
description: A monumental eclipsed disc; the wordmark is a tiny whisper beneath it.

name: Special delivery
description: A lilac postage stamp on paper, with a circular cancellation and tiny orbital engraving.

name: Long play
description: A huge grooved vinyl disc sits half off-screen beside a modest record-sleeve title.

name: Memory card
description: A chunky pixel cartridge floating on a powder-lilac background.

name: Connected dots
description: A wide constellation connects isolated points into one open-ended system.

name: Three bodies
description: Three tall art panels turn a star, an orbit, and a moon into a graphic sequence.

name: Soft geometry
description: A bright Swiss composition with a huge vertical rule and flat orbital geometry.

name: Departure
description: A diagonal pixel comet cuts through a restrained, left-aligned title.

name: Uncharted
description: An unfolded celestial map with coordinates, contour lines, and a single marked destination.

name: Event horizon
description: A wireframe rectangular tunnel pulls the eye toward a single distant light.

name: The monolith
description: A tall slab of violet light stands on a silent plane; the title stays low and small.

name: Resonance
description: A full-width violet waveform with a tiny centered title and generous silence.

name: Layer by layer
description: Exploded translucent isometric planes surround a central star.

name: Moon bulletin
description: A bold newspaper masthead and a large halftone moon on warm lavender paper.

name: Continuum
description: A woven torus made of intersecting orbital ribbons becomes an intricate central object.

name: Around the idea
description: The wordmark becomes a circular typographic orbit around a small violet planet.

name: Unknown terrain
description: Fluid contour lines form a terrain of possibility beside spare typography.

name: Launch structure
description: A pixel launch tower holds a star-shaped payload above a violet exhaust field.

name: Source of light
description: Columns of binary dissolve into a calm central clearing and a compact pixel mark.

name: One small beginning
description: A single bright pixel, a restrained wordmark, and almost nothing else.

name: The star atlas
description: Fifteen little celestial plates form a structured atlas beneath a quiet editorial heading.
